name: Andalucía
about: Spring (Semana Santa and the Feria de Abril, both in April) is the single most vibrant stretch of the year; summer heat here is genuinely extreme, regularly topping 40°C (104°F) in Seville.
overview: The Alhambra's Moorish palaces in Granada, Seville's orange-tree-lined streets and flamenco tablaos, Córdoba's Mezquita — the cultural heart of southern Spain.
costOverview: One of Spain's better-value regions — a full tapas plate with a drink runs just a few euros, and a flamenco show is the one real splurge most visitors add.

scenic.label: Clear spring & fall light on the Alhambra

specialSeasons.text: Semana Santa and the Feria de Abril fill Seville with elaborate processions, flamenco dresses and all-night fairground celebration — the busiest, most vibrant stretch of the year.
Peak summer heat regularly tops 40°C (104°F) in Seville — many locals leave, and outdoor sightseeing is best done early morning or evening.
